title: 1:1 & HC sync — hiring prep scratchpad
content:
Purpose:
- Prep notes for upcoming 1:1 with Rahul (hiring owner) + weekly headcount sync with Eng Platform leads. Keep short, surface blockers and decisions. Drafting interview loop and debrief template here for quick copy/paste.

Agenda (15–20m):
1) Quick HC snapshot (open reqs, offers, pending approvals) — 3m
2) Prioritization: which reqs to push this quarter vs next — 4m
3) Interview loop updates (panel gaps, calibration needs) — 4m
4) Hiring blockers (comp, approvals, SRE onboarding capacity) — 3m
5) Actions & owners — 2m

Headcount snapshot (rough):
- Headcount budget: 42 FTEs (platform eng org)
- Filled: 33
- Committed offers (acceptances pending start dates): 2
- Open reqs: 7 (2 infra eng, 1 infra lead, 1 runtime eng, 1 production infra SWE, 2 SWE growth)
- Available budget for hires this quarter: ~4 FTEs (subject to finance OK)

Open req notes:
- Infra Eng (REQ-412): need stronger senior IC candidates; interview loop missing a storage expert. Consider tapping SRE org for 1 panelist.
- Infra Lead (REQ-419): high comp expectation; we should decide on band and flexible equity before sending offer. Ask compensation team for benchmark.
- Runtime Eng: candidate pipeline okay; next on-site week of Mar 8. Confirm interviewer availability.

Interview loop (proposed, infra SWE):
- Screen (recruiter + hiring manager quick screen)
- Technical phone (systems design + performance) — 60m
- Practical task (take-home optional, small infra bug fix) — 2–3 days
- On-site (4 interviews):
  * Core systems design (40m)
  * Performance/benchmark debugging (30m) — bring laptop traces if possible
  * Team fit / cross-team collaboration (30m)
  * Hiring manager deep dive (30m)

Debrief template (for fast write-ups):
- Candidate: [name] | Role: [REQ] | Date: [mm/dd]
- Summary (50–100 words):
- Strengths (3 bullets):
- Risks/concerns (3 bullets):
- Recommendation: Strong hire / Hire with conditions / Hold / No
- Suggested comp band: [x–y] and equity note
- Required follow-ups: references / manager call / take-home review

Decision criteria (quick):
- Domain match: must have 1+ years of infra or runtime production experience
- Benchmarks: latency/cost tradeoff thinking, systems debug story, ownership examples
- Team fit: clear cross-team communication examples

Blocks & open questions for sync:
- Finance confirmation on hiring budget (send finance note before sync).
- Compensation team: can we pre-authorize 10% comp flex for infra lead?
- Interviewer availability: get final list by EOD Wed for Mar on-site slot.
- Onboarding ramp: SRE availability for training new hires (can we schedule week-of orientation?)

Actions (owner, ETA):
- Maya: email finance with headcount ask + context (by 2026-03-05)
- Evan: confirm panelists for infra reqs and ping SRE (by 2026-03-03)
notes_short: Working scratchpad for 1:1/hc sync; includes draft loop + debrief template; action list at bottom. Unresolved: finance OK + comp flex for lead.
